confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Vietnamese secondary-city pricing, not live listings. Food, beer and coffee anchors are the more reliable; cocktail and wine are inferred from the local beer relationship, and accommodation is less certain. The FX observation comes from search summaries of the RBA page (one earlier result showed an outdated March 2026 table), so verify it against rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Mekong Delta city, cheaper than Da Nang, Hoi An, Hue and Ho Chi Minh City, and broadly in line with other Vietnamese provincial cities of similar size.
